tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// bcom ldan 'das gtsug tor 'bar ba'i sgom bzlas kyi man ngag sreg byed me'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na maḥ.uṣṇī ṣa dzwā la kro dhend+ra ya/ bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i dbang po gtsug tor 'bar ba'i sgom bzlas kyi man ngag sreg byed me'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang*// gtsug tor 'bar ba la btud nas// de yi man ngag ches zab pa// brgyud pa'i gsung ni 'bri bar bya// 'dir bcom ldan 'das gtsug tor 'bar ba'i gdams pa 'di la rgyud sde gang las gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma gang las brgyud pa dang*/ gdams pa dngos kyi lag len dang*/ phyir zlog gi sgom bzlas dang*/ byad chu bo la bskyur ba dang lnga'o// dang po ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa sā la'i dbang pos gsungs pa/ slar yang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas dbang sgyur gyi gnas su/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud gsung ba'i tshe/ 'di nyid gsungs te/ rgyud de nyid las/ na maḥs manta buddhā nāṃ/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dzwa la dzwa la/ pra dzwa la pra dzwa la/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha te phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gtsug tor 'bar ba zhes grags pa'i// sngags 'di sngags rnams kun gyi mchog /gang zhig las rnams stong phrag ni// dgu bcu rtsa bzhi dag dang ni// bkra shis dpal grags thams cad dang*// rnam pa sna tshogs las rnams byed// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// lan gcig bzlas pas sel bar byed// las rnams gzhan yang byed pas ni// sngags rnams kun gyi bdag po yin// 'byung po kun gyi dbang byed dang*// bla ma yang dag sangs rgyas ni// sngags 'di dran pa tsam gyis ni// ltas ngan ma lus rab tu sel// rdzogs sangs rgyas pa lha yi lha// thub mchog gis ni de gsungs nas// yud tsam cang mi gsung bar bzhugs// de tshe gnas gtsang snang ba yi// lha tshogs dag kyang 'dug par gyur// lha rnams gtso bo thams cad dang*// rgyu skar gza' dang skar ma rnams// gtsug tor zhes bya'i mthu bo che// mthu mnyam mthu ni chen po ste// gtsug tor sngags kyi byin rlabs kyis// 'jigs shing dam tshig la gnas phyir// brgya phrag lnga'am bzhi dang ni// de bzhin bdun nam brgyad dam dgu// gnyis dang drug dang lnga dang bdun// gtsug tor dbang por rab tu grags// de ltar grangs dang grangs med ni// gtsug tor rgyal po dge ba yin// de dag dang ni sngags 'di mtshungs// sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/

sangs rgyas nyid kyis 'dzam bu'i gling kun tu yongs su grags pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po a bha yā ka ra la gnang*/ des sras kyi thu bo dge ba'i 'byung gnas sbas pa zhes bya ba rgya gar shar phyogs bhang ga lar sku 'khrungs pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po la gnang*/ des kha che'i paṇḍi ta chen po zla ba ltar grags pa buddha shrī dzñā na dang*/ paṇa chen grub thob ā nanda gupta la gnang*/ de gnyis kas chos rje chag lo tsā ba dgra bcom pa la gnang*/ des chag lo tsā chos rje dpal la gnang*/ des gtsang nags spug pa chos rje nyid kyi gdan sa pa mkhan chen dbang phyug shes rab la gnang*/ des chag lo rin po che bstan 'dzin dpal bzang po la gnang*/ des 'on 'dzag mo'i mkhas pa te'u ra'i zur khang du bzhugs pa dgung lo brgya bzhes pa grub chen maṅga laṃ shrī la gnang*/ des rje btsun dpal chen bzang po la gnang ngo*// yang chag lo gong mas/ grum ston dar ma shes rab la gnang*/ des grum ston brag phug pa shes rab dpal la gnang*/ des grum ston bsod nams bzang po la gnang*/ des rje btsun dpal chen bzang po la gnang*/ des chos rje rin po che ye shes dpal bzang po la gnang*/ des rgyal sras blo bzang dpal 'byor dang*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chos skyong bzang po la gnang*/ de yab sras gsum ka las rin chen chos rgyal gyis nos pa ste/ bla ma dam pa de rnams thugs rtsis shin tu che zhing phyir zlog la 'di kho na mdzad pas 'phral du grub pa myong grub yin zhes bzhed do// gsum pa gdams pa dngos kyi nyams len ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song bas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das gtsug gtor 'bar ba khro bo chen po/ sku mdog dmar po nyi ma bye ba'i gzi 'bar ba/ me zhun gyi thigs pa 'dzag pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

sbom zhing thung la gsus khyim che ba/ phyag g.yas pas ral gri me 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'i rtse la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa me 'bar ba 'khor ba/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ khro gnyer glog ltar 'khyug cing*/ spyan gsum dmar zlum phyogs bcur gzigs pas gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad la gzir ba/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen la 'bar ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang sbrul chun gyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me phung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyang bas byad ma dang 'byung po brdzis pa/ zhal nas sngags kyi nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ sku'i ba spu'i khung bu thams cad nas sprul pa'i khro bo mtshon cha sna tshogs par 'dzin pa mtha' yas pa spros pas srid pa gsum 'gengs shing gnod byed ma lus pa tshar gcod pa/ thugs kar pad nyi la gnas pa'i hūm̐ dmar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dgug gzhug bcings mnyes dbang du gyur/ dbang gi lha rigs lngas dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil bas rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ thugs kar pad nyi la hūm̐ dmar po'i mtha' mar gzungs sngags kyis g.yas skor du bskor ba las me 'od dpag tu med pa 'phros/ nad gdon byad byur rmi ltas ngan pa dang*/ dgra bgegs thams cad thal ba'i rdul du brlags par bsams la/ gzungs sngags nyer gcig gam brgya stong la sogs pa'i mthar/ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ rgyal ba'i gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing*// nyi ma bye ba'i gzi 'bar ba// gtsug tor 'bar ba zhes grags pa'i// khro bo'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal// zhes bstod/ bdag la rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ mtshan ma ngan pa dang*/ ltas ngan pa dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang*/

nad dang gdon dang gnod pa dang*/ bgegs dang bar du gcod par byed pa thams cad phyir zlog cig ces brjod cing thal mo brdabs te/ phrin las bcol la bsngo bas rgyas gdab bo// gal te rmi lam ngan pa rmis na/ dran shes bzhin dang ldan pas/ lus kyi 'dug tshugs ma zhig par byas la/ rmi lam ngan pa thams cad sreg par bsam zhing*/ sngags nyer gcig bzlas pa kho nas bzlog go /man ngag 'di la mchog tu yid ches pa dang*/ sngags dang ting nge 'dzin la rtse gcig tu ma yengs par 'bad par gnad dam pa'o// thun mtshams su gtor ma bya bar 'dod na/ dkar gsum gyi gtor ma a kā ros byin gyis brlabs la/ 'og min nas rang 'dra'i gtsug tor 'bar ba spyan drangs te/ de yi ljags las byung ba'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma bdud rtsir gyur pa drangs te gsol bas/ bde ba chen pos mnyes par bsams la/ rtsa sngags kyi sham bur/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'bul la/ mchod bstod dang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo// bzhi pa phyir zlog gi sgom bzlas ni/ sngar bzhin rang nyid gtsug tor 'bar bar bsgoms la/ ngag tu/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ g.yas skor du drag tu 'khor bas/ mi 'khor bar gnas pa lta bu'i nang du rang nyid dang bsrung bya thams cad chud par bsams la/ ngag tu hūm̐ zhes bcu brjod pas/ thugs kar hūm̐ las hūm̐ bcu phyir 'phros/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad kyi steng gi nam mkha' dang*/ steng gi rtsibs kyi rtse mo'i nub dang*/ 'og gi rtsibs kyi rtse mo'i shar gyi gnam mkha' la/ ye shes kyi khro bo bcu gtso bo lta bu zhal phyir bstan pa bskyed/ 'og min nas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dgug gzhug dbang bskur/ khro bo bcu la gtso bos dbur brgyan/ mchod pa lngas mchod/ bstod pas bstod la/ khro bo bcu las spros pa'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus byad ma sogs gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad bkug

'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi rtse mos sha khrag thor thor bcad de thal ba'i rdul du brlag par bsam/ yang 'khor lo las ches 'og gi sar rdo rje'i sa gzhi la mgo gtad de bzung ba'i khro bo brgyad kyi thad dang*/ 'og gi rtsibs kyi shar nub rnams su/ hūm̐ ring po bcu las byung ba'i dong gru gsum dmar nag 'bar ba bcu/ de'i nang du khro bo so sos sprul pa'i khro bo rnams kyis gnod byed thams cad bcug nas phur bus btab pa la/ mtshon cha du ma'i char phab pas rdul du brlag par bsam/ yang rdo rje'i sa gzhi me 'bar ba la drag tu brdabs pas kyang rdul du brlag par bsam/ de ltar yang dang yang du bkug la dmigs pa gsum po rim bzhin bsgoms la/ gzungs sngags bzla bal brtson par byas na/ rmi lam du nags mes bsregs/ chu bo bsgyur/ shing gcod/ brag bshig g.yul rgyal/ srog chags gsod brdungs byas pa sogs rmi ste/ gzhan gyi byad dang rig sngags kyi sbyor ba ngan pa byas pa rnams mi bzlog pa mi srid do// lnga pa byad chu bo la bsgyur ba ni/ chu bo chen po'i 'gram du phyin nas kha lhor blta ba'am/ gnod phyogs su bltas te/ mdun du stegs kyi khar/ ra lug gi ril ma dang*/ bong ba dang*/ spen ma brgya rtsa brgyad bsham/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ rang yi dam gyi lha gang yin pa'am/ gtsug tor 'bar bar bskyed la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad nyi la gtsug tor 'bar ba sngar bzhin bzhugs par bsgom/ de'i g.yas su padma dang zla ba'i steng du 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo dbu gsum gyi dbus dkar g.yas sngo g.yon dmar ba/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas bzhi na gdugs dkar po/ 'khor lo/ lcags kyu/ gzhu/ g.yon bzhi na rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga/ mda'/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ shin tu khros shing ma rungs pa thams cad 'jigs par byed pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/

g.yon cung zad brkyang ba'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'bar ba'i g.yon du padma nyi ma'i gdan la/ rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ phyag na rdo rje sngon po/ g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing 'jigs par byed pa/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa can/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar zlum/ dbu skra dmar po gyen du 'bar ba/ sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis log 'dren glang sna can brdzis pa/ de gsum gyi 'khor du sangs rgyas byang sems/ rig sngags kyi lha tshogs mtha' yas pas bskor nas bzhugs par bsam/ rang dang lha gsum gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang ngam bsgrub bya la gnod par byed pa'i gnod byed sogs gzhan gyi rig sngags kyi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad bsdus te/ mdun gyi rdzas la thim par bsams la/ bden stobs brjod/ de nas 'bar ba'i gzungs sngags kyi mjug tu/ tadya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ a tsa le a tsa le/ kha ṣa me kha ṣa me/ khi ṣi me khi ṣi me/ she ṣa me she ṣa me/ bī ra bī ra/ bi ṣa me bi ṣa me/ sau me sau me/ shānte shānte/ dānte dānte/ badzra dhā ra bhandha bhandha/ badzra pā ṇi phaṭa/ oṃ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi bhandha bhandha/ badzra pā she na sarba duṣṭaṃ bi nā ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarba sa twāshtsa swā hā/ bdag che ge mo la rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ mtshan ma ngan pa dang*/ ltas ngan pa dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang*/ nad dang gdon dang gnod pa dang*/ bgegs dang bar du gcod par byed pa thams cad/ ril ma bzhin tu chus khyer cig /bong ba bzhin du chus shig cig /spen phyags kyis phyogs shig /ces brjod bong ril spen gsum chu bor bskyur bas/ lha gsum gyi 'od zer gyis bdas te/ rgya mtsho chen por khyer te dag par bsam/ de lta bu brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bar du byas la thal mo brdab/

dmigs med kyi rgyas btab/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo'o// 'di ni rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ byad ka dang phur gtad la sogs pa byung na bya ste/ de ma thag bzlog par 'gyur ba spen gtor ma zhes grags pa yin no// de ltar dam pa'i man ngag ches zab pa// gsang bar 'os pa brjed byang tsam nyid du// bris la rig pa'i lha rnams bzod mdzad cing*// dge ba'i 'od kyis bdud dpung bsreg gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das gtsug tor 'bar ba'i sgom bzlas kyi man ngag sreg byed ma'i mtshon cha zhes bya ba/ shākya'i dge slong rin chen chos kyi rgyal pos bya 'dul ba chen po'i gdan sar sbyar ba'o// ༈ /na maḥ.uṣṇi ṣa dzwā lā ya/ dpal mgon sangs rgyas stong gi rig sngags sku// bcom ldan gtsug tor 'bar ba zhes grags pa// drag shul rnam 'gyur bye ba'i rngam stabs kyis// ma rungs gdul dka' 'dul mdzad khyod la bstod// dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// dmar gsal nyi ma bye ba'i 'od chags sku// ba spu'i khung re nas kyang me zhun gyi// thigs 'dzag bgegs dpung sreg mdzad khyod la 'dud// phyag g.yas ral gris gdon tshogs phye mar gtubs// phyag g.yon bdud snying 'byin mdzad sdigs mdzub rtser// drag 'khor me lce'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pas// bdud bgegs nyon mongs gcod mdzad khyod la bstod// glog 'dra'i khro gnyer rab 'khyug sma ra dang*// smin ma dbu skyes gyen 'bar tshwa tshwa 'phro// rab khros spyan gsum bgrad pa'i sdang mig gis// gzir bas sa gsum skrag mdzad khyod la 'dud// zhal gdangs rno dkar mche gtsigs ljags 'dril zhing*// 'byung ba'i khrag dron chang gis rab myos pa'i// gad rgyangs 'brug stong ldir ba hūm̐ gi sgras// ma lus srid gsum g.yo mdzad khyod la 'dud// klu dbang rin chen rgyan gyis rnam par mdzes// zab yangs stong gsum shong ba'i gsus khyim 'khyil// khrag bgos stag lpags gsar ba'i na bza' g.yo// 'jigs rungs gshin rje gsod mdzad khyod la 'dud// padma nyi ma'i gdan la g.yon brkyang zhabs// stangs stabs brgya phrag gar gyis log 'dren rdzi// sen rnon lcags kyus byad ma'i snying phral te// chem chem zhal du gsol mdzad khyod la 'dud// bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa yi// 'gal rkyen phyi nang bar du gcod pa'i tshogs// nad gdon sdig sgrib nyes ltung ma lus pa// ye shes me lces cig car bsreg par mdzod// rmi lam mtshan ma ngan dang mi shis pa// bza' nyes bsgoms nyes gshed byed byad stems dang*// rbad 'dre rbod gtong bsam sbyor ngan pa rnams// gang gis rtsom pa de la phyir zlog mdzod// tshe dpal bsod nams yid kyi shing rta gang*// chos dang bkra shis bde skyid phun tshogs rnams// yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin du 'phel ba dang*// mi mthun bdud las rgyal ba'i phrin las mdzod// sangs rgyas stong gi rig sngags chen po bcom ldan 'das gtsug tor 'bar ba la bstod cing*/

phrin las 'chol ba'i rab tu byed pa 'di ni shākya'i dge slong rin chen chos kyi rgyal pos rong smu'i rnam sras gling du sbyar ba'o// ༈ /khro bo gtsug tor 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang byad 'grol dang bcas pa'i lag len rnam gsal me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// wā gind+rā nanda ni rā bho gā ya na maḥ dpal stug rgyal ba'i gtsug tor las 'khrungs pa// gang sku bsgom zhing rig sngags bzlas tsam gyis// yid srubs snying gi brtan pa rang dbang du// 'phrog byed gtsug tor 'bar bas rtag tu srungs// sgrub thabs rjes gnang bde 'byung ral pa'i klung*// 'dren mchog drang srong dzahnu'i zhal sgo nas// legs brgyud zab khyad yan lag brgyad ldan rgyun// nyes brgya'i dri ma sbyong byed 'di spel lo// de la'ang 'dir khro bo'i rgyal po gtsug tor 'bar ba'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ bdag bskyed ni/ oṃ swā bhā wa sogs brjod pas 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ yig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das gtsug tor 'bar ba khro bo chen po/ sku mdog dmar po nyi ma bye ba'i gzi 'bar ba/ me zhun gyi thigs pa 'dzag pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sbom zhing thung la gsus khyim che ba/ phyag g.yas pas ral gri me 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'i rtse la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa me 'bar ba 'khor ba/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ khro gnyer glog ltar 'khyug cing spyan gsum dmar zlum phyogs bcur gzigs pas gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad la gzir ba/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen la 'bar ba/

stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang sbrul chun gyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me phung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pas byad ma dang 'byung po brdzis pa/ zhal nas sngags kyi nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ sku'i ba spu'i khung bu thams cad nas sprul pa'i khro bo mtshon cha sna tshogs par 'dzin pa mtha' yas pa spros pas srid pa gsum 'gengs shing gnod byed ma lus pa tshar gcod pa/ thugs kar pad nyi la hūm̐ dmar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas rang 'dra'i gtsug tor 'bar ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas dgug gzhug bcing dang dbang du bya/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lngas oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ thugs kar pad nyi la gnas pa'i hūm̐ dmar po'i mtha' mar gzungs sngags kyis g.yas skor du bskor ba las me 'od dpag tu med pa 'phros/ nad gdon byad byur rmi ltas ngan pa dang dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul bzhin du brlag par bsams la/ na maḥs manta buddhā nāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā nāṃ/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dzwa la dzwa la/ pra dzwa la pra dzwa la/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha te phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i gzungs nyer gcig la sogs pa gang 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar oṃ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ rgyal ba'i gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing*// nyi ma bye ba'i gzi 'bar ba// gtsug tor 'bar ba zhes grags pa'i// khro bo'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ bdag la rmi ltas ngan pa dang*/ mtshan ma ngan pa dang*/

ltas ngan pa dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang*/ nad dang gdon dang gnod pa dang bgegs dang bar du gcod par byed pa thams cad phyir zlog cig ces brjod cing thal mo brdabs te gnod pa phyir zlog pa'i phrin las bcol/ gal te bdag bskyed rkyang pa nyams su len na skyabs 'gro nas 'di'i bar nyams su blangs la dge ba byang chub tu bsngo'o// gal te rmi lam ngan pa rmis na dran shes bzhin dang ldan pas lus kyi tshugs ma zhig par byas la/ rmi lam ngan pa thams cad sreg par bsam zhing sngags nyer gcig bzlas pa kho nas bzlog go /man ngag 'di la mchog tu yid ches pa dang*/ sngags dang ting nge 'dzin la rtse gcig tu ma yengs par 'bad pa ni gnad kyi dam pa'o// zhes gsungs so// phyir zlog gi sgom bzlas dang*/ bstod pa rgyas pa rnams don du gnyer bas chag lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i yi ger blta bar bya'o// rjes su gnang ba ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la/ stegs kyi steng du maṇḍal tshom bu gcig bkod/ de'i mdun du zlum gtor rgyan ldan bshams pa'i mtha' chu gnyis nyer spyod dang*/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ me tog sogs nye bar mkho ba rnams tshogs par byas la/ mchod pa rnams oṃ a mṛ tas bsangs pa nas byin gyis brlab pa spyi dang mthun/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas brtsams te bdag bskyed sgom bzlas kyi mthar thal mo brdabs te gnod pa phyir zlog gi phrin las 'chol ba'i bar gong ltar nyams su blang*/ mdun bskyed ni/ tshom bu bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma zhes pa nas rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan pa'i bar gyis tshom bu lhar bskyed/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas so so'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ uṣṇī ṣa dzwa la sa pa ri wā ra re re'i sngon du 'gro ba'i arghaṃ nas shabda swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ gong gi bstod pas bstod/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur par bsams la/

a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ lha'i ljags las byung ba'i 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bdud rtsi drangs te gsol bas mnyes par bsams la/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha khā hi khā hi btags pa lan gsum 'bul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad bya'o// de nas slob ma rnams bos la me tog bkye bsdu grub nas slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal gdab/ 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni rig sngags 'chang ba'i sde snod thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa bya ba'i rgyud yin/ de la rgyud sde sgo drug tu dbye ba las 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la nang gses kyi dbye ba brgyad yod pa'i ya gyal de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi khro bo chen po dang gtsug tor 'bar ba zhes bya ba ste/ de'ang sngon tshe de bzhin gshegs pa sā la'i dbang pos gsungs shing*/ slar yang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas dbang sgyur gyi gnas su 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud gsungs pa'i tshe bzlas te gsungs shing*/ rtsa rgyud de nyid las 'di'i rig sngags gsungs pa/ na maḥs manta buddhā nāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā nāṃ/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dzwa la dzwa la/ pra dzwa la pra dzwa la/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha te phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gtsug tor 'bar ba zhes grags pa'i// sngags 'di sngags rnams kun gyi mchog /gang zhig las rnams stong phrag ni// dgu bcu rtsa bzhi dag dang ni// bkra shis dpal grags thams cad dang*// rnam pa sna tshogs las rnams byed// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// lan gcig bzlas pas sel bar byed// las rnams gzhan yang byed pas ni// sngags rnams kun gyi bdag po yin// zhes bya ba la sogs pas mngon par bsngags pa'i yul du gyur pa gang de/ ma hā paṇḍi ta a bha yā ka ras yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas las mnos shing*/ de nas bhaṃ ga la'i paṇḍi shū raṃ ka ra gupta nas bdag cag gi 'khor lo'i mgon po'i bar gyi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa las legs par 'ongs pa'i gdams pa thugs rtsis shin tu che zhing*/

bla ma gong ma rnams kyang phyir zlog pa 'di kho na mdzad pas 'phral du myong bas grub pa'i gdams pa khyad par can 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba la slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub nas/ khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob dpon la khro bo'i rgyal po gtsug tor 'bar ba dngos yin snyam pas rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po sogs kyis gsol gdab dang*/ rgyud yongs su dag par bya ba'i slad du/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs kyis gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la khro bo chen po gtsug tor 'bar ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes pa rnams lan gsum gsum gyis rjes zlos byar gzhug dngos gzhi la/ rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i phyir du slob ma rnams swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma lhar bskyed la/ ye shes pa mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ khro bo khro mo rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul nas gtsug tor 'bar ba dpag tu med pa spyan drang*/ sngags kyi mthar dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra ā we sha ya aḥ.āḥ zhes btags pa yang yang brjod pas slob ma la bstim/ des gtsug tor 'bar ba'i sku'i byin rlabs zhugs sogs kyis brda sprad/ rjes gnang dngos la lung gsum las/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa chad de/ slob ma'i thugs kar 'khod pa'i dmigs pas sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byar gzhug slob mas bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags sogs dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs nas/ khro bo chen po gtsug tor 'bar ba'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig

ces brjod cing me tog 'thor ba'i bar dang*/ dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du khro bo chen po gtsug tor 'bar ba yi dam gyi lhar bzung bar bgyi'o zhes lan gsum gyis rjes zlos byar gzhug des gtsug tor 'bar ba'i gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs sogs kyis brda sprad/ byin gyis brlab pa'i lung gi slad du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa la rnam pa khro bo chen po gtsug tor 'bar ba'i sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa re chad/ khyed rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim pas thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang dbyer med du gyur pa nas spros bral gyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa'i bar 'dra/ des gtsug tor 'bar ba'i thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs sogs kyis brda sprad/ rjes gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal dang*/ lus longs spyod rnams kyi 'bul gyis bzhes snyam pas/ deng nas brtsams te sogs ni spyi ltar brjod cing*/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa zhes pas/ dge ba bsngos te slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang ngo*// rjes ni/ mchod pa kha gsos te byin gyis brlabs nas mchod bstod byas la 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol ba dang*/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs dang*/ oṃ badzra muḥ zhes pas tshom bu'i ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim zhes dang*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /gtsug tor 'bar ba 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam gang shes brjod do// 'di la brten nas rang ngam bsgrub bya la byad gtad kyi gnod pa dang*/

rmi ltas ngan pa sogs byung na byad chu bor bskyur ba'i gdams pa lag tu blang ba'i tshul ni/ chu bo chen po'i 'gram du phyin pa'am/ phyin par bsams la mdun du sla nga la sogs pa'i snod du chu blugs la gzhag rang nyid kha lhor bstan pa'am gnod byed kyi phyogs su bltas pa'i mdun du stegs kyi khar ra lug gi ril ma dang*/ bong ba/ spen ma brgya rtsa sogs ji ltar rigs pa bsham/ bsgrub bya la rjes gnang dang 'brel bar byed na slob dpon gyis bya bar 'os pa rnams grub par byas nas rjes gnang gi thog mtha' gang rung du bya zhing*/ zur du byed na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas rang yi dam gyi lha gang yin pa'am/ gtsug tor 'bar ba'i sgom bzlas sngar ltar bya'o// de nas bsgrub bya yod na mdun du 'khod du gzhug la/ 'dir grub pa'i slob dpon chen po a bha yā ka ra nas chag lo tsā ba gong ma dgra bcom pa sogs la rim par brgyud pa'i khro bo gtsug tor 'bar ba dang rjes su 'brel bar/ byad chu bor bskyur pa'i las kyi rim pa'am spen gtor mar grags pa zab mo sgrub pa la/ khyed rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar pam̐ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du zhes sogs nas/ gnod byed ma lus pa tshar gcod pa zhes pa'i bar gyis sngar ltar gtsug tor 'bar ba gsal gdab/ de'i g.yas su padma dang zla ba'i steng du 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo can ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gsum gyi dbus dkar/ g.yas sngo g.yon dmar ba/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas bzhi na gdugs dkar po dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ gzhu 'dzin pa/ g.yon bzhi na rgyal mtshan dang*/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa dang*/ mda' dang*/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ shin tu khros shing ma rungs pa thams cad 'jigs par byed pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ g.yon cung zad brkyang ba'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/

'bar ba'i g.yon du padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing 'jigs par byed pa/ g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub can/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ dbu skra dmar po gyen du 'bar ba/ sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis log 'dren glang sna can brdzis pa/ de gsum gyi 'khor du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rig sngags kyi lha tshogs mtha' yas pas bskor nas bzhugs par gsal btab/ rang dang lha gsum gyi thugs ka'i zhes sam slob dpon dang mdun gyi lha gsum dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ khyed rang gi sgo gsum la bar du gcod par byed pa'i nad gdon byad gtad la sogs pa gzhan gyis rig sngags kyi sbyor ba ngan pa byas pa thams cad tshur bsdus nas mdun gyi rdzas rnams la thim par mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin cing hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas te/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka'= chos kyi bka'= dge 'dun gyi bka' bden= de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka'= bcom ldan 'das gtsug tor 'bar ba khro bo chen po'i bka'= gsang sngags dang rig sngags kun gyi bdag po lag na rdo rje'i bka'= dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ rdo rje slob ma'am/ sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo zhes bya ba'i lus ngag yid gsum la bar du gcod par byed pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib/ rmi lam ngan pa/

ltas ngan pa/ dus ma yin par 'chi bar 'gyur ba thams cad dang*/ byad dang mnan gtad du bcug pa la sogs pa gzhan gyis rig sngags kyi sbyor ba ngan pa brtsams pa'i nus mthu thams cad rang dbang med par bkug nas mdun gyi rdzas 'di dag la gnyis su med par thim par gyur cig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes bden pa'i stobs brjod pa'i dgug gzhug lan gsum bya/ de ltar byas pas ril ma la sogs pa'i rdzas 'di dag nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'dus pa'i rang bzhin du gyur par mos/ mdun gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las 'od zer rlung gi shugs dang ldan pa dang sprul pa'i khro tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ rdzas de rnams rang dbang med par bdas te rgya mtsho chen por dor bar mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod de/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas spen ma thogs te phyags pa'i tshul dang bcas te 'bar ba'i gzungs sngags kyi mjug tu/ tadya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ a tsa le a tsa le/ kha ṣa me kha ṣa me/ khi ṣi me khi ṣi me/ she ṣa me she ṣa me/ bi' ra bī ra/ bi ṣa me bi ṣa me/ sau me sau me/ shānte shānte/ dānte dānte/ badzra dhā ra bhandha bhandha badzra pā ṇi phaṭa/ oṃ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi bandha bandha badzra pā she na sarba duṣṭaṃ bi nā ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarba satwāshtsa swā hā/ bdag dang che ge mo la rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ mtshan ma ngan pa dang*/ ltas ngan pa dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang*/ nad dang gdon dang gnod pa dang*/ bgegs dang bar du gcod par byed pa thams cad ril ma bzhin du chus khyer cig bong ba bzhin du chus shig cig spen phyags kyis phyogs shig ces brjod cing*/ spen ma dang bcas pa chur dor/ de lta bu brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa byas pa'i mthar phyir zlog par gyis shig med par gyis shig zhi bar gyis shig ces brjod cing thal mo brdabs pas khyed rnams zla ba sgra gcan las grol ba ltar sgo gsum bar chad dang bral nas bde ba dang ldan par mos la/

'khor gsum ga'ang dmigs pa med par shes pa'i lta ba zab mo'i rgyas btab ste dge ba byang chub tu bsngo'o// rang nyid kyis nyams su len pa'i tshe bar skabs kyi dmigs pa'i brda sprod rnams ngag gis mi brjod cing yid kyis bsam pa dang rang dang slob ma'i khyad par bsgyur ba min pa 'dra'o// 'di ni rang gzhan la rmi lam ngan pa dang byad kha dang mthu gtad drag po byas pa la sogs pa'i rtags byung na 'di nyid nyams su blangs pas de ma thag tu bzlog par 'gyur bar the tshom med pa'i gdams pa'o// smras pa/ rig sngags bye ba'i gtsug tor ngal gso ba// gang gi sgom bzlas bgyis ba'i g.yar lam du// bgegs dgra byad ma'i srog rtsa rdo rje'i khams// grub kyang skad cig gnyis par 'tsho'am ci// gang de'i sgrub thabs rjes su gnang ba dang*// byad gtad chu bor bskyur ba'i lag len rnams// dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' ngur smrig gar// rmor chen mkhas pa'i gsung don rnam gsal byas// 'dir byas dge tshogs 'phongs skyen dga' byed mdas// bar chad bsam sbyor ngan pa'i bden bral srog /yongs phrogs bdud las rgyal ba'i khang bzang du// kun mchog sī tā'i bde la rol gyur cig /ces khro bo gtsug tor 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang byad 'grol ba dang bcas pa'i lag len rnam gsal me long zhes bya ba 'di ni/ chag lo rin rgyal gyi gsung rab dang*/ rmor chen pa'i phyag gzhes ltar nyams su blang bde bar bande tshul rin gyis bris pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
